desc: Derive the core reduction: for fixed center c and y>=1, kept size is 1+(y+1)*#{neighbors v of c with deg(v)-1>=y}; answer is N minus the global maximum kept size over all centers and y.

Implement the O(N) global y-sweep: compute deg(v) and cap(v)=deg(v)-1, group vertices by cap, sweep y downward, activate vertices with cap==y, increment counters of all their neighbors, track maxCounter, evaluate 1+(y+1)*maxCounter when maxCounter>0, and output N - bestKept.
Validate the implementation on the three provided samples (all PASSED) and reason through edge cases (path of length 3 -> 0, star -> 0, snowflake with y=1 and y>1).
